messages:
lauren: Quick thread — we need to lock the run-of-show for the May 12 webinar and finalize breakout/demo fallback plans. I sketched a minimal flow and an invite A/B test for subject/CTA. Thoughts?

sam: love it. can you paste the run-of-show here?

lauren: sure — short version:
```
00:00 - Host intro (5m)
05:00 - Product narrative + benchmarks (15m)
20:00 - Live demo: Gen endpoint + latency/cost dashboard (12m)
32:00 - Breakouts (3x rooms) (10m)
42:00 - Panel QA + audience Q (10m)
52:00 - CTAs + close (8m)
```

priya: breakouts need clear prompts. recommend: 1) Dedicated vs Hosted use cases, 2) Ops/Runbook for scaling, 3) Hands-on prompt engineering. moderators?

lauren: yes — diego will moderate a room, zoe can take the ops room. Sam can cover prompt engineering.

diego: ok i'm good for the ops room. can we plan one dry run focused on failovers? want to rehearse model fallback + region routing.

lauren: exactly — dry run #2 will be a failover drill. Agenda: simulate region outage -> auto-fallback to compatible model -> confirm session doesn't lose state.

eng-ops: calendar-bot scheduled rehearsal 1: 2026-05-05 15:00 UTC, rehearsal 2 (failover drill): 2026-05-10 16:00 UTC. Invites sent to lauren, sam, priya, diego, zoe.

zoe: perfect. for demo fallback, can we have a lightweight script to toggle capacity tiers? I can run a CLI command during rehearsal.

sam: I'll prepare a short snippet to demo KV cache hit rates + token cost delta. Something like:
```
# pseudo
start-demo --model redwood-x --cache-prefix sample-set
show-metrics --since 5m --keys "latency,cost,kv_hit"
```

priya: invite A/B test thoughts: Subject A: "See how to cut LLM inference costs 3x — live demo" Subject B: "Live: Low-latency LLM serving at scale (benchmarks + demo)" CTA A: "Reserve my spot" CTA B: "Save my seat — demo inside" Aim: 50/50 split, track CTR + registration -> qualified lead rate.

lauren: love the two subject lines. let's also segment by persona — startups vs enterprise. Startups get the cost-focused subject, enterprise gets SLA/reliability angle. We'll route enterprise signups to the AE queue, startups to self-serve flow.

zoe: routing rules proposal:
- enterprise: company_size > 250 OR email domain in our partner list -> route to sales-enterprise queue
- mid-market: company_size 50-249 -> send to SDR nurture
- startup: <50 or student domains -> self-serve nurture + quickstart guide

diego: can we add a hidden field to capture "primary interest" (benchmarks, ops, prompt engineering) on reg form so we can assign to breakout room automatically?

lauren: yes — add a required select with those 3 options. default to 'benchmarks' if blank. We'll wire review to the registrant tags.

priya: rehearsal checklist (short):
- Confirm presenters slides + demo repo link (by 2026-05-01)
- Dry run #1: runthrough slides + timing (2026-05-05)
- Dry run #2: failover drill (2026-05-10)
- QA script + panel questions (by 2026-05-08)
- Invite A/B start 2 weeks before event

sam: added: backup demo video (2min) in case live endpoint fails. Hosted on S3 and ready to switch in 30s.

lauren: messaging notes for hosts: keep benchmark claims explicit (percent improvements, test conditions), call out SLOs and fallback behavior, and close with a single CTA and next step.

zoe: CTA copy candidates for A/B: "Try Redwood for free" vs "Get a performance audit". I prefer mid-funnel CTA for enterprise.

lauren: agreed — variant mapping:
- Startup segment: Invite Subject A + CTA "Try Redwood for free"
- Enterprise segment: Invite Subject B + CTA "Get a performance audit"

diego: any objections to shipping invite copy tomorrow? I can draft and drop in #marketing-drafts.

priya: go for it. i'll pair on the enterprise copy.

lauren: cool. final action items:
- diego: draft invite + reg form with hidden interest field (due EOD 2026-04-20)
- sam: demo scripts + backup video (due 2026-05-01)
- zoe: routing rules + tag mapping (due 2026-04-22)
- priya: A/B plan + persona mapping (due 2026-04-22)
- lauren: host script + panel q bank (due 2026-04-25)

lauren: thanks all — dropping slides + invite draft link here when done. :rocket:
